requirement_match.summary: The isolated integration and console privacy controls match approval, but America/Chicago is not saved because required factual GA4 business fields remain literal ellipses.

security.summary: Consent remains fail-closed, advertising consent remains denied, prohibited event APIs are absent, pnpm lifecycle scripts are explicitly denied, and the owner accepted the scoped existing Next.js audit risk.

code_quality.summary: Sequential lint, typecheck, 30 unit tests, 54 core E2E tests, two Firefox/WebKit smoke tests, six Analytics E2E tests, production validation, Firebase preflight, and the 37-route build passed on the complete candidate.

failure_paths.summary: Disabled, invalid, unsupported, declined, revoked, repeated initialization, storage failure, and blocked third-party network paths are covered.

error_handling.summary: Analytics dependency failures remain a bounded no-op and do not block page content, navigation, CTA, or media interaction.

production_readiness.summary: Candidate validation and rollback preparation pass, but the approved GA4 reporting timezone is incomplete; deployment and Realtime verification therefore remain unrun.

trade_offs.summary: Owner accepted existing transitive Next.js audit risk for this rollout; internal traffic stays Testing with IP pending; only consenting traffic is measurable.

findings.problem: Industry, business size, and business objective remain unspecified, so the Console cannot save America/Chicago.
findings.production_impact: Deploying now would violate the approved reporting-timezone acceptance criterion.
findings.correction: Owner must provide the three factual GA4 selections; then save and verify property details before deployment.

findings.problem: The exact pnpm frozen-install command is rejected by the environment command policy.
findings.production_impact: Local evidence uses pnpm's successful lockfile/up-to-date resolution and zero automatically ignored builds rather than the exact command; App Hosting build remains the authoritative install proof.
findings.correction: Treat the Cloud Build install as a deployment stop condition and roll back before traffic verification if it fails.

residual_risks: The owner accepted the scoped sharp/PostCSS advisories inherited from the existing Next.js tree; no untrusted image or CSS processing path was found.
Internal IP/CIDR remains pending and Internal Traffic remains Testing.
Realtime represents opted-in traffic rather than all HTTP requests.
limitations: No Realtime or DebugView receipt exists.
The governed runtime review recorder and task-report CLI are unavailable in this checkout.
